sources.snippet: Despite its small size, it can still generate fairly precise and legal moves in SAN. The Chaturanga model comes in the following sizes: Nano, Neo (Nano+), Mini, Pro and Ultra (Pro+) Estimated parameters: ~50M Architecture: Llama Intended use: as an experimental chess-playing SLM

sources.title: DireDreadlord/Chaturanga-Nano · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: Chaturanga Nano is a 25M variant based on the Supra2-Medium-Base which has been finetuned on 200,000 rows from the chessllm dataset. Despite its small size, it can still generate fairly precise and legal moves in SAN. The Chaturanga model comes in the following sizes: Nano, Neo (Nano+), Mini, Pro and Ultra (Pro+)

sources.title: DSiddharth24/Chaturanga: AI vs AI Conversational Chess - GitHub
sources.snippet: 🌟 Overview Chaturanga is an immersive AI-versus-AI chess spectacle named after the ancient 6th-century Indian game of strategy (Chaturanga, meaning "four arms" of the military: infantry, cavalry, elephants, and chariots) that served as the progenitor of modern chess.
